request: Add an async function to the extensions crud module that returns the count of installed extensions, for the admin page.

summary.result_text:
I added `get_installed_extensions_count` to `lnbits/core/crud/extensions.py`, right after `get_installed_extensions`. I haven't run it or any `make` targets. The import check was blocked on approval, and I never ran `make check` or `make test-unit`.

```python
async def get_installed_extensions_count(conn: Connection | None = None) -> int:
    row: dict | None = await (conn or db).fetchone(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM installed_extensions"
    )
    return int(row["count"] or 0) if row else 0
```

It runs a single `COUNT(*)` query rather than loading every extension model. It follows the existing `conn or db` pattern.

The name was already imported and listed in `__all__` in `lnbits/core/crud/__init__.py`. It is also already called in `check_extensions_limit` in `lnbits/core/services/extensions.py:246`. Before this change, importing `lnbits.core.crud` would have failed with an `ImportError`. I didn't add any admin page or route code. The function is ready to call from there.

Only `lnbits/core/crud/extensions.py` changed.
